Miss Yonge would be obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](../others.html#111) would send a copy of the [Story of the Christians and Moors](../books.html#126) to [Madame de Witt](../persons.html#423), Boulevarde Hausseman Paris[^1]

[^1]: Endorsed \'Post Jan 20\'.
